passives.name: Unified Hearts
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Always reduces the damage taken by allies from attacks that target all allies by [Buff_V_tower_element_52468_2]. (Triggered Effect) Upon taking damage from an attack that targets all allies, activates an Agile Response effect. Grants all allies Sustained Recovery for [Buff_T_tower_element_52468_3] turn(s).
